verdict.rationale: The only mention of webhooks in the evidence pack is an indirect community comparison noting Recurly automates retention 'without needing to implement webhooks' for dunning, implying webhook functionality exists, but no first-party documentation, API reference, or event-list evidence describes how to subscribe to or configure webhooks.
